Name: Pharmacist in the Forest
Author: NECOooooo
Description:
If you add a mod, you'll add 8 potions, and you'll also get a recipe (there are acquisition conditions) to make that potion!
There's an additional production base where you can create a potion, and there's an additional 1 event where you can get it!
Also added is a mini quest for one potion make! (There are conditions)
Potion recipes can be obtained through books that drop probabilities from trees, and are divided into three categories.
After you get the book, you can get the recipe when you go home.


[u][b]Spoiler! The instructions are written on the file.[/b][/u]
[size=6]
This mode supports English, Korean, Chinese, and Japanese.[/size]
